title: LiberiaFix - Service Marketplace Platform
description: Multi-service marketplace PWA connecting customers with local service providers across Liberia with dual booking systems and mobile money integration.
fullDescription:
LiberiaFix revolutionizes service discovery in Liberia through a comprehensive marketplace platform featuring innovative dual booking systems and seamless payment integration. The platform solves Liberia's centralized service discovery problem by connecting customers with verified service providers through instant booking or competitive bidding.

Built as a Progressive Web App optimized for low-bandwidth environments, LiberiaFix features MTN Mobile Money integration for secure payments, real-time messaging for seamless communication, and a freemium provider model to reduce entry barriers. The platform serves 500+ verified providers across 15+ service categories, processing payments securely through local mobile money while maintaining 99.8% uptime.
problem: Liberia lacks a centralized digital platform for finding and booking reliable service providers. Most transactions happen through word-of-mouth, leading to trust issues, pricing inconsistencies, and limited provider visibility. The market needed a solution that works in low-bandwidth environments while supporting local payment methods.
solution: Architected a full-stack Progressive Web App with dual revenue streams: direct booking ($3 fee) and competitive bidding ($7 fee). Implemented MTN Mobile Money integration for seamless payments, real-time messaging for communication, and a freemium provider model to reduce entry barriers.
features: Dual booking system (instant booking & competitive bidding)
Comprehensive security with Row Level Security
Dual table architecture for legacy support

title: Silenvia - AI Therapy Companion
description: A culturally-aware AI therapy companion offering personalized mental health support across diverse cultural backgrounds with blockchain-powered privacy.
fullDescription:
Silenvia revolutionizes mental health care by providing culturally-sensitive AI therapy that adapts to users' cultural backgrounds. The platform offers complete UI transformation, therapeutic approaches, and recommendations based on African, Western, Middle Eastern, and Asian cultural contexts.

Featuring dual AI therapy modes with text-based sessions powered by Gemini AI and video-based interactions using Tavus personas, Silenvia ensures privacy through Algorand blockchain integration for anonymous mood tracking. The platform includes comprehensive mood analytics, gamification elements, and multilingual support with culturally appropriate translations.
problem: Traditional mental health apps lack cultural sensitivity and adaptation. Different cultures have varying approaches to emotional expression, help-seeking behavior, and therapeutic preferences, creating barriers for users from diverse backgrounds seeking mental health support.
solution: Silenvia provides culturally-aware AI therapy that completely transforms its interface, therapeutic approaches, and recommendations based on the user's cultural background. The platform uses advanced AI for personalized therapy while maintaining privacy through blockchain integration and offers comprehensive mood tracking with culturally-relevant emotional expressions.
features: Dual AI therapy modes (text + video personas)

title: Pharmacy E-Commerce Platform
description: A comprehensive e-commerce platform for Liberian pharmacies to sell medications online with integrated payment processing, prescription verification, and delivery coordination.
fullDescription:
A full-featured e-commerce solution designed specifically for Liberian pharmacies, enabling secure online medication sales with prescription verification and integrated payment systems. The platform features MTN Mobile Money integration alongside Cash on Delivery options, prescription upload and verification workflows, and comprehensive order management dashboards for both staff and administrators.

Built as a Progressive Web App optimized for low-bandwidth environments common in Liberia, the platform includes real-time WhatsApp notifications for order updates, Supabase Row Level Security for data protection, and installable PWA capabilities allowing customers to use it like a native mobile app. The platform streamlines the entire pharmacy workflow from customer browsing to delivery coordination while maintaining regulatory compliance through prescription verification.
problem: Liberian pharmacies lacked an accessible digital platform for selling medications online. Customers had limited access to essential medications, especially in remote areas, and pharmacies needed a solution that works with local payment methods while ensuring prescription verification for controlled substances and maintaining regulatory compliance.
solution: Developed a comprehensive pharmacy e-commerce platform with dual payment options (MTN Mobile Money + Cash on Delivery), prescription verification system, PWA capabilities for app-like experience, staff and admin dashboards for complete order management, and WhatsApp integration for real-time customer notifications. The platform is optimized for Liberia's low-bandwidth environment while maintaining security through Supabase Row Level Security.
features: Full e-commerce functionality with product catalog
Progressive Web App (installable like native app)
Staff dashboard for order and inventory management
Row Level Security for data protection

title: Salone Haven - Real Estate Platform
description: A comprehensive real estate platform for Sierra Leone, connecting buyers, sellers, and agents with advanced search capabilities and interactive mapping.
fullDescription:
Salone Haven addresses the Sierra Leone real estate market's need for a modern, reliable platform. The application centralizes property listings that were previously scattered across social media and word-of-mouth networks, providing advanced search capabilities and professional transaction management.

The platform features Google Maps integration for location-based searches, virtual property tours, mortgage calculators, and secure document management. It's optimized for the local market with support for local currencies, payment methods, and multiple languages to serve both local and international users interested in Sierra Leone real estate.
problem: Sierra Leone's real estate market lacked a centralized, professional platform for property transactions. Most listings were scattered across social media platforms or shared through word-of-mouth, making it difficult for buyers to discover properties and for sellers to reach potential customers effectively.
solution: Salone Haven provides a comprehensive real estate platform with advanced search and filtering, interactive Google Maps integration, virtual tours, and secure transaction management. The platform is specifically optimized for the Sierra Leone market with local payment integration and multi-language support.
features: Advanced property search with keyword and location filters
Interactive Google Maps with property markers
Property image galleries and virtual tours

title: Crown Prince Inc. - Corporate Website
description: Professional corporate web presence with dynamic quote generation tools for construction and services company.
fullDescription:
Crown Prince Inc. is a modern, professional website built for a construction and services company, featuring dynamic quote generation and project estimation tools. The platform provides a comprehensive corporate presence with interactive tools for client engagement and project cost calculation.

The website includes multiple service pages, a dynamic quote generator allowing customers to generate instant quotes based on service selection and project specifications, and an advanced project cost estimator that factors in materials, labor, and timelines. Built with Next.js for optimal performance and SEO optimization, the site delivers a perfect experience across all devices with validated contact forms and comprehensive service portfolio showcases.
problem: Construction company needed professional online presence with interactive tools for client engagement and project estimation without manual calculations.
solution: Developed comprehensive corporate website with multiple pages, dynamic quote generation system for various services, and interactive project cost estimator.
features: Dynamic quote generator with instant calculations
Service portfolio showcase with past projects
Validated contact forms with React Hook Form
Full SEO implementation with meta tags
